tools.name: search_offerings
tools.description: Find relevant offers of docks. This is vendor information from docks only, not an independent market comparison. No lead is created.

tools.name: get_product_information
tools.description: Read sourced docks capabilities, limits and links. Unknown integrations and prices must be clarified; never infer guarantees.

tools.name: assess_requirements
tools.description: Check buyer requirements against evidence. Returns met, unmet or unknown and questions for the buyer. Does not create a lead.

tools.name: prepare_inquiry
tools.description: Prepare a private inquiry draft only when the buyer wants to contact docks. Return the reviewUrl to the buyer for review and explicit submission in their browser. Do not open or approve it on their behalf. Keep accessToken private. Drafts are not handed to sales.

tools.name: submit_inquiry
tools.description: Retrieve the submission receipt after the buyer has approved the review page. An unconfirmed draft is rejected. Repeated calls cannot create duplicate leads.

tools.name: get_inquiry_status
tools.description: Read only this inquiry using its private access capability. A pending handover is not delivered. Cannot read other inquiries.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: prepare_inquiry, submit_inquiry · Private data: prepare_inquiry, get_inquiry_status · Public sink: submit_inquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: prepare_inquiry, submit_inquiry · Private data: prepare_inquiry, get_inquiry_status · Public sink: submit_inquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
